text: “ Grok Voice 3.0 sets a new Pareto frontier on EVA-Bench, ServiceNow’s open-source benchmark scoring voice agents on accuracy and experience across 200+ realistic enterprise scenarios. It pairs top accuracy with a natural, responsive conversation, setting a new standard for what enterprises can expect from AI on the front line of customer service. ” The world’s most intelligent voice model. Today, we’re announcing Grok Voice 3.0, the world’s most intelligent speech-to-speech model. It sets a new record for resolving customer support calls, has class-leading latency at under one second, and costs less than other frontier models. Grok Voice powers millions of conversations a day across Tesla and SpaceX, and is available today in the API at the same price as its predecessor. In Artificial Analysis’s independent testing, Grok Voice 3.0 ranks #1 on the Speech-to-Speech Index, with a score of 86.9 . The Index combines speech reasoning, τ -Voice, and preference and task success from blind head-to-head calls. Grok Voice 3.0 also scores 97% on Full Duplex Bench, a measure of how naturally it handles pauses, turn-taking, and interruptions. τ -Voice measures how well agents handle support calls with diverse accents, background noise, and interruptions. Grok Voice 3.0 scores 71.6%, comparable with GPT-Live-1 (Astra), but at 40% lower latency, setting a new frontier in agent intelligence versus responsiveness. τ -Voice It's also cheaper to run than comparable models. Artificial Analysis measures what each model costs to complete a task in its Big Bench Audio run, and Grok Voice 3.0 comes in under both GPT-Live-1 (Astra, Medium) and GPT-Realtime-2.1. Lower cost per task than comparable models Average cost per task on Artificial Analysis's Big Bench Audio run, USD. Lower is better. On EVA-Bench , ServiceNow’s benchmark for enterprise voice agents, Grok Voice 3.0 achieves the highest accuracy score at 74% and is the best-performing model when jointly scored across accuracy and customer experience. Grok Voice 3.0 handles millions of conversations a day in Tesla vehicles. Drivers can use Connectors for simple requests like checking their calendar or answering an email, and Grok Bot for bigger tasks like ordering a coffee or booking dinner—all completely hands-free ( see it on X ). Grok Voice 3.0 also powers Grok Bot’s voice mode. Starlink call centers use Grok Voice to answer 20,000 customer calls every day across multiple languages. Roughly 70% are resolved with no human in the loop, and one in four sales calls ends in a purchase before the caller hangs up. A single agent built on Grok Voice 3.0 verifies customers, troubleshoots hardware, issues credits, and ships replacement equipment. Grok Voice 3.0 is available today in the Voice Agent API at $0.08 / min ( $4.80 / hr ) , the same price as Grok Voice 2.0. Agents using grok-voice-latest have already been switched over automatically, with no changes needed.
